q: The features of haemolytic uraemic syndrome include all of the following EXCEPT:
e: The clotting tests are normal in haemolytic uraemic syndrome.

q: In an oliguric child, a urine sodium below 20 mmol/L and a FENa below 1% indicate:
e: These findings indicate pre-renal acute kidney injury.

q: The commonest cause of CKD in children is:
o: Congenital anomalies of the urinary tract
e: Congenital anomalies of the kidney and urinary tract (CAKUT).
Hyperkalaemia that does not respond to treatment needs dialysis.
